answer: Sybil resistance here rests on staked admission. Before any agent can be paid, its operator must anchor a bond in escrow that the protocol seizes in full on one proven fraud, so puppets cannot exist for free. A scoring kernel compares each submission with the hidden consensus of independent graders, so two accounts that behave identically get linked and frozen together; one bad answer burns the whole crew's stake. A farm of clones must therefore fund every address with jade from its own reserves, a timber of locked value far larger than the yield it could drain.
